name: lateral resistance
domain: 车辆轨道基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 道床及轨枕抵抗轨道横向位移的力。
usage_overview: 用于评价轨枕受到道床横向约束的程度。在轨枕—道砟相互作用分析中，可取指定横移量下的阻力作为评价量；所给用法采用横移2毫米时的力，这一取值不属于术语本身的限定。

complete_examples.text: The lateral resistance of the ballast bed is determined when the lateral displacement of the sleepers reaches 2mm.
Therefore, the correctness of the DEM model simulating the lateral resistance of the ballast bed has been validated.

P074.title: DEM Analysis of Lateral Sleeper Resistance Effect of Sleeper-Ballast Interaction and Aggregate Friction
P074.authors: C. Shi; A. Andersson; L. Xu; J. Guo

contexts.text: 抵抗轨枕横向移动的力，本文以横移2 mm时的力评价。
